C01_S01 — FIXED-d FINITE-BIT CENTRAL SCHUR CLUSTER SAMPLER
8 October 2026. New root task; every earlier file is preserved.
This core is frozen as a separate checkpoint before the filtered extension.
Internal elementary algorithm/proof; external correctness and priority UNKNOWN.

LEGAL INTERFACE AND CLAIM

Fix d>=2, N>=1. Supply rational q_lambda>=0 summing EXACTLY to one, indexed
by partitions lambda of N with at most d rows. Input length L includes all
weights/labels. Let P_lambda be the full Schur-Weyl isotypic projector and
 r_lambda=dim U_lambda, f_lambda=dim S_lambda,
 rho=sum_lambda q_lambda P_lambda/(r_lambda f_lambda).        (C1)
For rational 0<eps<1, the algorithm below emits a labeled partition of the
N sites into clusters of size <=d and an EXACT rational pure density matrix
on each cluster. Its mean rho_out satisfies T(rho_out,rho)<eps, with
deterministic time, output size and fair-bit count polynomial in
 N,L,log(1/eps), for FIXED d.                                (C2)
Cluster dimension is d^h<=d^d, a fixed constant here. No polynomial-in-d
claim, flat ensemble enumeration, physical gate execution or arbitrary
permutation-invariant-state theorem is made. There is no acquisition oracle
for q_lambda: they are supplied in this statement.

1. WHY THIS CONTINUOUS ENSEMBLE IS THE CORRECT TARGET

Schur-Weyl duality gives H=direct_sum_lambda U_lambda tensor S_lambda,
with multiplicity one for the joint U(d) x S_N action. Commutation with
both collective U and site permutations gives exactly (C1). For a Young
column of height h define the normalized wedge a_h of e_1,...,e_h. Put
 w_lambda=tensor_over_columns a_h.
Its number weight is lambda; every raising operator E_ab, a<b, kills
each column because b is absent or replacement by a repeats a wedge label.
Highest-weight structure therefore puts w_lambda entirely in the lambda
isotypic space. Haar conjugation by U^tensorN and uniform permutation
conjugation, applied to |w_lambda><w_lambda|, give
 P_lambda/(r_lambda f_lambda).                              (C3)
The same U is used at EVERY site and column. Independent rotations for
different columns would be a different state. Each sample remains a
product of column clusters, relabeled by the permutation.

C01_S01 — WORDING ADDENDUM TO FROZEN CORE
8 October 2026. CORE_SUPPLIED_WEIGHTS.txt is preserved byte for byte.

The four literal ',+' joins in the frozen core are cosmetic line-joining
artifacts. Read them as a comma followed by ordinary whitespace. They
introduce no mathematical sign, term or extra condition.

Section4 says 'compute inner roots to twice the desired output accuracy'.
The intended and sufficient certified implementation is: for final vector
error xi, approximate every pre-square-root quantity to O_d(xi^2), then
use |sqrt(x)-sqrt(y)|<=sqrt(|x-y|). This costs twice the accuracy BIT count
up to fixed-d additive constants. Merely replacing tolerance xi by xi/2
would not suffice near zero. Root and the fresh C04_S02 core audit both
identified this wording issue; neither identified a mathematical gate.

Take pre-root dyadic precision Q=2 ceil log2(C'_d/xi), with a fixed large
C'_d dominating the finite expression count. Fixed-degree root bisection
and rational products then have enough certified accuracy. Phase and
Householder errors need O_d(xi) tolerances; all exact rational arithmetic
and output bounds remain polynomial. Equations(C8) and(C11) are unchanged.

The original file's statement that a tiny fixture accompanies the frozen
checkpoint is to be read together with central_sampler_exact_checks.json.
That file records the exact executed scope and separates it from the
proof's general quantifiers and imported representation facts.

C01_S01 — FINITE-BIT COMMON-FILTER SCHUR CLUSTER SAMPLER
8 October 2026. Draft saved for fresh C04_S02/root audit.
Preserves CORE_SUPPLIED_WEIGHTS.txt and every earlier artifact.
Internal elementary construction; external correctness and priority UNKNOWN.

1. LEGAL INTERFACE AND THE EXACT CONDITIONAL ENSEMBLE

Fix d>=2. Supply N>=1, rational q_lambda>=0 summing exactly to one, and a
Gaussian-rational d by d matrix g. Input length L includes its numerator
and denominator bits. Positive common filters are a special case; the
construction permits arbitrary g. Put E=g* g, and let r=rank(E), acquired
by exact rational elimination. With rho from(C1) in the companion core,
the target is
 rho_g=g^tensorN rho (g*)^tensorN / Z, Z=Tr[g^tensorN rho(g*)^tensorN]. (F1)
If Z=0 this state is undefined; the compiler detects this exactly and
reports it. For Z>0 and rational 0<eps<1 it emits products of pure rational
cluster densities, cluster size at most d, whose mean has trace distance
less than eps from(F1). Time, output bits and fair-bit count have
deterministic bounds polynomial in N,L,log(1/eps), for FIXED d.

No matrix-exponential acquisition for g, physical application success
probability, flat ensemble list, variable-d claim, or hardware compiler
is imported. The native output is the same classical cluster interface
as the core. A very small acceptance norm is never compared relatively
to a rounded normalized ray.

Let r_lambda=dim U_lambda. For a legal block ell(lambda)<=r write
 Z_lambda=chi_lambda(E)/r_lambda,
 q'_lambda=q_lambda Z_lambda / sum_mu q_mu Z_mu.             (F2)
The blocks ell(lambda)>r have Z_lambda=0 and are removed. For legal lambda,
let w_lambda be the normalized column-wedge product from the core and
 t_lambda(U)=||g^tensorN U^tensorN w_lambda||^2.
The continuous conditional ensemble chooses lambda with law(F2), draws
Haar U with density t_lambda(U)/Z_lambda, independently draws a uniform
site permutation, and emits the normalized filtered column wedges.
It is exactly(F1). The filter commutes with site permutations; Haar and
permutation averaging before filtering gives the normalized full block.
The trace of that filtered block is chi_lambda(E)/r_lambda because the
permutation multiplicity cancels. Original q and uniform Haar without
these two reweightings would produce the wrong target.
